items.title: Strategy premium to its bitcoin: market cap ÷ value of BTC held (mNAV)
items.description: Strategy's mNAV, diluted market cap divided by the value of its bitcoin, weekly since Jan 2025. It fell from about 2.2x to below 1x and was 0.90x on Oct 30, 2026.
items.reason: Bloomberg reports Strategy's enterprise value is now below its bitcoin holdings, and JPMorgan calls it a capitulation signal.

items.title: Bitcoin treasury companies: weekly net BTC flows (last 3 months)
items.description: Weekly BTC bought vs sold by public bitcoin treasury companies. Treasuries were net sellers in the weeks of Nov 8 (10,520 BTC sold) and Nov 15 (15,162 BTC sold).
items.reason: Bitcoin is back near $61K, and treasury companies trading below their bitcoin value are selling coins.

items.title: Gold/silver ratio (ounces of silver per ounce of gold)
items.description: Gold/silver ratio, ounces of silver per ounce of gold, monthly since 1995. It fell from about 101 in early 2025 to 66.9 in Sep 2026.
items.reason: Silver jumped about 7% and gold 2.7% this morning.

items.title: The Scale of the AI Buildout
items.description: Big US build-outs as a share of GDP: the AI build-out averages 3.63% of GDP at a 5.1% peak, above railroads (2.24% avg, 4% peak), telecom and fiber, highways, electrification and canals.
items.reason: Nasdaq futures are up about 3% as investors move back into AI stocks after a bruising November.

items.title: SpaceX valuation: private tenders → xAI merger → IPO → market
items.description: SpaceX valuation path from a $210B tender in Jul 2024 to the $1.77T IPO, a $2.79T peak close on Jun 16, 2026, a $1.43T low on Aug 5 and $1.95T on Oct 20, 2026.
items.reason: Tesla-SpaceX merger talks are moving forward, and Musk has pledged two SpaceX shares to every US child's Trump Account.
